# Image inventory

All photographs are real, openly licensed photographs from Wikimedia Commons, chosen for Indian (and wherever possible Chennai) subjects. No AI-generated imagery. Files were cropped to 4:3 and exported at 800 px and 1600 px as JPG and WebP. Attribution for CC BY / CC BY-SA images is published on `photo-credits.html`, which is linked from the footer; keep that page live while these photos are in use.

Where no suitable open-licence photo existed for the exact subject (keys at a door, an empty interior, an inspector with a camera, a balcony), the nearest genuine subject was used and is flagged below. Replacing those with Flourrish's own photography of managed properties (with owner permission) is the single biggest remaining visual upgrade.
